visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A crowd of pedestrians walks along a sidewalk adjacent to a busy city street during daylight. A young man in a beige long-sleeved shirt and grey cargo pants walks toward the camera with a neutral expression. In the background, there are various urban buildings, shop signs, and traffic lights. (2) The scene cuts to a man with dark hair wearing a green bomber jacket and blue jeans standing in front of a white promotional booth. He holds a cup of instant noodles and a fan of colorful cards. The booth features a large banner with red and black text and a QR code. (3) The man from the first scene and several companions run excitedly toward the man in the green jacket. They have wide smiles and appear to be cheering or shouting. A woman in a blue cap and blue overalls is seen among them. (4) A series of close-up shots show the man in the green jacket interacting with different individuals. He hands out themed cards with cartoon characters and text such as "桃花盛FUN" and "脂肪ByeBye". The recipients show expressions of amusement and surprise. (5) A man with a backpack and a white t-shirt approaches the man in the green jacket and speaks urgently. Both men's facial expressions shift from cheerful to shocked. They turn and run away from the booth together as the camera follows their movement. (6) The video concludes with a static close-up shot of the promotional banner and the instant noodle product, showcasing the brand logo and campaign details.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat electronic track featuring a steady 128 BPM synthesizer beat. Ambient street noises of distant traffic and low-level crowd chatter are audible in the background. No vocals are present initially. (2) A sudden burst of high-pitched group cheering and shouting "Bà zǒng" erupts, indicating high arousal. A cartoon-style "pop" sound effect punctuates the excitement. The music volume swells slightly as the atmosphere becomes very animated. (3) A clear male voice with a professional yet friendly narrative tone asks a question. A female voice responds briefly with a smile in her tone. A digital "sparkle" or "ding" sound effect is triggered, mimicking a magic wand sound. (4) The main male speaker's pitch rises in an inquisitive manner. Another male guest answers in a flatter, more conversational tone. A comedic "spring" sound effect and a vocal "Bye Bye" sample play in succession, timed with the onscreen interaction. (5) An urgent male voice breaks in with rapid speech and high intensity, reporting something alarming. The primary male speaker reacts with a sharp, surprised intake of breath. A rapid-fire series of "whoosh" transitions and an alert sound conclude the active dialogue. (6) The BGM fades into a final punchy electronic stinger as a single, enunciated slogan is spoken by the narrator, ending the track with high production clarity.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Series of Interactions -> Twist Ending -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional comedy sketch for 'Sui Yuan' (隨緣) instant noodles. It uses a street interview format where a 'CEO' character (Bà zǒng) interacts with passersby during a religious pilgrimage, giving them themed 'good luck' cards associated with the noodle brand. The goal is to build brand affinity through humor and relatable social interactions.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is centered around a promotional booth for Sui Yuan noodles, featuring product displays, brand banners, and constant verbal and visual mentions of the product and its slogan.
